asks: Is "a computer cannot get more than it has" a principle for every addition?
answer: Yes. A computer cannot get more than it has. Every addition is asked whether it gives a computer more than it has, and who grants it then.

sets.says: A computer cannot get more than it has.
sets.asks: Does it give a computer more than it has? Then who grants it?
sets.why: Access is handed down, never up.
